compiled_state.description:
## Context / Problem
S2 needs a lean contract that can describe routes and locate one execution/help parser without importing handlers or optional dependencies. Existing command sets and parser styles cannot be migrated safely until factory, formatting, validation, and compatibility rules are fixed.

## Approach
Add a stdlib-only CLI parser foundation and immutable route registry.

- Define a narrow factory protocol equivalent to `build_parser(*, prog: str) -> argparse.ArgumentParser`.
- Provide one Rebar ArgumentParser/formatter customization for deterministic width/order/newlines and compatibility-preserving parse errors/return control. It extends argparse; it does not define another grammar.
- Let route records hold lazy handler and parser-factory references plus identity/alias/visibility/help, mount/init, confirmation/output, and possible-capability metadata.
- Validate duplicate spellings, illegal alias/retired collisions, contradictory policies, unknown capability ids, malformed references, and resource/parser census state without resolving command handlers.
- Derive the legacy policy-set exports from routes and run a shadow comparison against all current sets/arms. Do not cut help or execution over in this task.
- Define reusable argument-definition composition for canonical/nested/compatibility spellings so aliases can vary `prog`/epilog without copying options.

The formatter policy is an explicit byte contract: fixed width independent of terminal, deterministic command/option ordering, UTF-8 LF output, and one trailing newline.

## Compatibility and Rollback
No public behavior changes. Existing help files and execution ladder remain authoritative. Reverting this task removes only unused expansion scaffolding.

## Testing
Use in-process unit tests with synthetic factories/routes. Observable oracles are exact formatted bytes, parse success/failure without process termination, deterministic validation findings, derived-set parity, and blocked imports proving registry construction resolves no handlers or optional packages.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] The factory protocol and shared argparse customization produce deterministic help and compatibility-shaped parse errors from one parser object.
- [ ] Frozen route records represent every current spelling and derive compatibility policy exports with zero shadow-census delta.
- [ ] Registry validation rejects each synthetic duplicate, contradiction, unknown capability, malformed reference, and alias/retired collision deterministically.
- [ ] Import blockers prove registry construction and route lookup import neither handlers nor optional dependencies.
- [ ] No runtime help or execution path has cut over, and rollback is removal-only.
